notes:
🧾 Buy quotes / invoices by % of market:
• Type the market price on each line; we pay the buy % (default 70%) — or give a line its own %. Lines without a market price take a typed amount
• Store credit % (default 80%, 0 = cash only): the customer sees both totals and picks cash or store credit when accepting a buy quote online; paying out in store credit takes the credit amount
• Customer sees market prices + % (default) or only what we pay — per document, default in Settings
• Draft → 🧾 Buy quote (link) brings each card's market price and keeps the offer's exact cash and store credit totals
